environment.description: Terraform Cloud agent running on an ECS Fargate task in a VPC subnet (10.0.44.0/24) configured with route table rtb-0a3f7c that has only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for S3 (pl-63a5400a -> vpce-0b7e). The subnet's route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry — neither to an IGW nor to a NAT Gateway. DNS resolution is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The ECS task's security group (sg-0f4d2a8) has egress rules limited to TCP/443 toward the VPC endpoint prefix list only. ACME_METRICS_ENDPOINT is set but resolves to a private IP (10.0.44.200) running a no-op stub. CloudWatch Logs are written via the com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs VPC endpoint (vpce-0c9a1f) with an endpoint policy restricting PutLogEvents to the specific log group /ecs/terraform-agent only.

vpc_endpoints: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs (interface, vpce-0c9a1f, policy: allow PutLogEvents to /ecs/terraform-agent only)
config.network_acl: deny all ingress/egress to 0.0.0.0/0 except VPC CIDR
